changes.text: Batch export/import dialogs stay over the preferences window instead of opening behind it
Batch export correctly reads selected PDFs and shows the folder picker from Settings
Install control is hidden unless an update is available
Update row is quieter: one version signal, text-style Install, clearer progress while installing
Progress text says PDF annotations during batch export/import; import match list is cleaner
Batch export opens a dialog to pick PDFs by collection; batch import lets you choose multiple JSON backups
Removed trailing ellipses from export and import button labels
Preferences update controls are quieter; install progress is shown, and a successful install stops further update checks until restart
Preferences can batch-export selected PDFs and batch-import a folder of backups matched by filename or item title
Preferences copy is more formal; single-PDF export and import remain on the item context menu
Import/export no longer fails with DataCloneError when reading PDF text across the reader worker boundary
Opening a PDF after import no longer shows "can't access dead object" from a closed background reader tab
Importing a backup into a different PDF (publisher vs. arXiv, or an edited file) finds each annotation again by its text
Before importing, lists annotations that cannot be placed and why
Updates are no longer installed automatically; the preferences show the new version and install it when you click
Preferences UI is shown in Chinese
Update check compares the highest version from GitHub raw, jsDelivr, and the latest release page
Update check no longer trusts AddonManager's stale cache; it takes the newest version from multiple mirrors and installs via the XPI link
Update check no longer trusts a stale CDN copy; it picks the newest version from GitHub raw and other mirrors
Preferences show the installed version, check for updates, and list the changelog
Redesigned the preferences layout and controls
Removed Smaller note icons
Change annotation color from the edit toolbar
Export and import PDF annotation backups; restore all highlights, underlines, and margin comments only when the target PDF is identical
When margin cards no longer fit, scroll the column instead of using Show all / Collapse
While writing a new comment in Zotero's annotation popup, wait until the popup is closed before showing the margin card
In-card scrolling for long comments; card height follows the text up to about nine lines
Scrollbar tinted with the annotation color—dim when idle, bright while scrolling
Drag to select card text for copy (Ctrl/Cmd+C); click to edit
Hide Zotero's annotation popup when a margin card is already shown; annotations without a card still use the built-in popup
Comments display in full by default (no three-line clamp)
Comment cards in the PDF margins, with leaders pointing to the marks
In-place editing with bold / italic / underline / strikethrough, super/subscript, sizes, and lists
Format toolbar only while editing; card border uses the annotation color
Toolbar toggle, annotation context menu, and annotation type filters
Compatible with Zotero 7.x – 10.*
